mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Savage Gorger
# "At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on
# this creature."  Trigger frame + intervening if: `parse "At the beginning of your end step, if an
# opponent lost life this turn, draw a card."` (B13-end-step+if); effect: Scion of the Swarm's
# PUT_COUNTER on the source (B9-gain-life-counter-self).
end_step_counter = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.END_TURN,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        event=LifeLostEvent(
            actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [end_step_counter, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: End-step trigger: B13-end-step+if frame with the turn-history condition EVENT_THIS_TURN(LifeLostEvent(actor=OPPONENT)); effect is Scion of the Swarm's PUT_COUNTER on the source. Self-check packs (scratch): counter after an opponent loses life, none without.
